I have been farming this small plot for many years using our traditional ways. At my age, I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer or improved seeds from the market, and the rains here in the South South are enough for my cassava and yams. My children and grandchildren will help with the planting, weeding, and harvesting, so we do not need to hire outside workers.
